name: Physics Free Body Diagrams
description:
Create a physics lesson flipchart about Free Body Diagrams (FBDs) in ActivInspire.

Your task is to create a 3-page flipchart saved as '/home/ga/Documents/Flipcharts/physics_fbd.flipchart' with the following structure:

1. Page 1 (Title): Title 'Free Body Diagrams' and subtitle 'Newton's Laws of Motion'.

2. Page 2 (Flat Surface): Title 'Object at Rest'. Draw a horizontal line (table) with a rectangle (box) sitting on it. Draw two arrows/lines: one pointing DOWN labeled 'Fg' (Gravity) and one pointing UP labeled 'Fn' (Normal Force). Add text 'Fnet = 0'.

3. Page 3 (Incline): Title 'Object on Ramp'. Draw a large triangle (ramp). Draw a rectangle (box) resting on the slanted side. ROTATE the rectangle so it sits flush against the ramp. Draw three arrows: 'Fg' pointing straight down, 'Fn' pointing perpendicular to the ramp (up/left), and 'Ff' (Friction) pointing up along the ramp.

Note: Use the Shape tool for the box and ramp. Use the Line or Shape tool for arrows. Use the Text tool for labels.
